# Voke Platform Full Context Specification for LLM & AI Search Indexers

> Voke (https://www.tryvoke.in) provides AI-driven technical mock interviews, resume parsing, ATS scoring, interactive coding environments, and company-specific technical preparation.

## Platform Features & Functional Endpoints

### 1. AI Voice & Video Mock Interviews
- URL: https://www.tryvoke.in/voice-assistant
- Description: Real-time voice interface powered by WebSockets and WebRTC audio processing. The AI acts as a senior technical interviewer (Google/Amazon bar raiser persona), asking follow-up questions based on candidate responses, evaluating technical depth, time complexity, edge cases, and soft skills.

### 2. Company Interview Question Kits
- Base URL: https://www.tryvoke.in/companies
- Supported Companies: Google, Meta, Amazon, Apple, Microsoft, Netflix, Uber, Airbnb, LinkedIn, Twitter, Tesla, Spotify, Adobe, Salesforce, Oracle, IBM, Intel, NVIDIA, AMD, Cisco, PayPal, Stripe, Slack, ByteDance, Snapchat, Reddit, Dropbox, GitLab, GitHub, Atlassian.
- Details: Each company route (e.g., https://www.tryvoke.in/companies/google) contains frequency-weighted interview questions, problem categories (DSA, System Design, Behavioral), difficulty levels, and AI-assisted solution walkthroughs.

### 3. Curated Data Structures & Algorithms Sheet
- URL: https://www.tryvoke.in/dsa-sheet
- Description: Handpicked problem set structured by topic (Arrays, Two Pointers, Sliding Window, Trees, Graphs, Dynamic Programming, Heap/Priority Queue). Candidates can solve problems directly in the browser IDE with instant multi-language code execution.

### 4. AI Resume Builder & ATS Scanner
- URL: https://www.tryvoke.in/resume-builder
- Description: AI-assisted ATS resume scoring, bullet point rewriter using the Action-Verb + Metric + Result formula, and automatic question generator based on resume projects.

### 5. Peer Mock Interview Network
- URL: https://www.tryvoke.in/peer-interviews
- Description: Peer-to-peer interview matching platform where software engineering students practice 1-on-1 mock interviews, grade each other using standardized rubrics, and track feedback over time.

## Data Protection & Security Standards

- All candidate resume uploads and interview audio recordings are encrypted in transit via TLS 1.3 and at rest using AES-256 encryption.
- Fully compliant with India DPDP Act and international privacy frameworks.
- Data Security Policy: https://www.tryvoke.in/privacy
